slug: 2025-12-29 Review of Angola's Proposed Law on Artificial Intelligence

facts.fact: TechHive Advisory reviews a draft Artificial Intelligence law introduced in Angola, a comprehensive framework for the development, supply and use of AI with a risk-based approach and extraterritorial reach; the document gives no date for the draft, so its published date of 2025-12-29 is used.

The MINTTICS public consultation portal lists the Proposta de Lei Sobre a Inteligencia Artificial as a document under consultation and records 18 contributions from companies, 18 from specialists and 5 from the general public; the portal is undated, so the capture date of 2026-08-27 is used.

note: Angola's AI rules are described as provisions inside a revised data protection law (automated decisions), which is class other; the article says Angola is not drafting a standalone AI law, but it states no absence of AI regulation.

facts.fact: CAZOS says a dedicated AI law drawn up by MINTTICS (86 articles, nine chapters) has been in public consultation since September 2025 and is not in force.
Portal de TI reports that Angola's Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligência Artificial is in public consultation, and that the country does not yet have AI-specific legislation.
facts.system: Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligência Artificial

note: Nothing stated on an Angolan AI law.

facts.fact: Minister Mario Oliveira told the ITU PP-26 plenary that the Artificial Intelligence Law is in preparation, with no completion deadline given.

note: Minister says legislation is only being considered; no draft begun.

facts.fact: Angola's communications minister told the ITU PP-26 that the Artificial Intelligence Law is currently being prepared.
Angola's Ministry of Telecommunications (MINTTICS) has had a draft AI law in public consultation since September 2025, with prison terms of 1 to 12 years and fines up to Kz 1.5 billion for firms.

facts.fact: PTI reports that the MINTTICS draft AI law, 86 articles in nine chapters covering governance, supervision and sanctions, is in public consultation.

facts.fact: Angop reports that the 29 April 2026 agenda of the Council of Ministers included appraising the proposed Law on Artificial Intelligence, an initiative of the Ministry of Telecommunications, Information Technologies and Social Communication.

facts.fact: MINTTICS's national director of telecommunications says the Proposta de Lei de Inteligência Artificial, with complementary diplomas, is under review by the Council of Ministers.
